# Content-addressed LLM Cache

This module provides a content-addressed cache for storing and retrieving LLM outputs based on a key derived from the input, template, version, and model. The cache ensures that identical requests yield the same cached outputs, and makes it possible for failed runs to retain their prepaid answers, optimizing subsequent re-runs.
